asset.title: Overband belt magnet separator
asset.description: Cross-belt overband magnetic separator at about real size: a 1200 mm troughed ore conveyor (three-roll 35 degree idler sets, channel stringers, legs, return idlers and return belt, ore load, head pulley with motor and gearbox, discharge hood, tail pulley) under a four-column steel gantry, with the magnet hung on four chains. Self-cleaning version: magnet block inside a cleated cross belt on two pulleys with its own drive, terminal box, tramp-iron chute and scrap bin with caught steel. Plate-magnet version: finned suspended magnet box without a belt. Material controls: magnet paint, gantry and conveyor steel, belt rubber and ore, plus a magnet type choice. weathered, safetyOrange and highVisibility presets.

asset.title: Inline skate
asset.description: Recreational inline skate at about real size: soft boot with toe cap, laces, padded tongue and heel counter; hinged moulded cuff with power strap and buckle; extruded aluminium frame with four 80 mm wheels, hub cores and axle bolts; heel brake pad. Material controls: synthetic boot fabric, molded cuff polymer, frame aluminium, urethane wheels, lace and strap accent; clubColors, aggressive and weathered presets.

asset.title: Strip-light batten set
asset.description: Ground row of three 1 m cyc strip lights at about real size: trapezoid trough housings with end caps, eight round colour cells each alternating warm and cool circuits, gel-frame runners, rear connector box, and a floor trunnion stand with pivot knobs at each end tilting the trough up at the cyc. Material controls: housing, stand hardware, warm and cool colour cells. houseShow, touring and cycRGB presets.

asset.title: Blackout curtain drive
asset.description: Greenhouse blackout screen rack-and-pinion drive at about real size: two columns with a cross beam, a gearmotor with finned motor and limit-switch box on the drive shaft, bearing blocks, pinion gearboxes, toothed racks pushing the aluminium leading-edge profile, support wires and a black-over-white blackout screen running out from its folded package. Material controls: structure, gearmotor, screen top and screen underside, plus screen position (open, half, closed). blackout, energyScreen, shadeScreen and weathered presets.

asset.title: Roll cage trolley
asset.description: Four-castor roll cage at about real size: low deck on swivel castors, three tall mesh walls (two sides and the back) of tube frames filled with welded wire, optional fold-down mid shelf and coloured retaining straps across the open front. Material controls: wire mesh, deck, castors, straps. galvanized, warehouseBlue and chilledGreen presets; shelf choice.
